payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over possible count of digit 7, compute corresponding count of 4 if remainder divisible, minimize total digit count and then prefer more 4s.
payload.rationale: Solution performs a linear scan over number of 7s to find optimal combination of digits minimizing total length and then preferring smaller leading digits. This exhaustive search over one variable to find the best solution aligns with branch and bound more than other complete search subtypes.
